title: Basic Gen AI Chatbot
description: A simple chatbot that uses AI to answer questions using a serverless architecture.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a complete chat application. It uses Amazon S3 to host the website interface you see in your browser. When you send a message, it goes through Amazon API Gateway to an AWS Lambda function. This function sends your text to Amazon Bedrock, which generates the AI response. The conversation history is saved in Amazon DynamoDB so you can keep track of what was said. It is a serverless setup, meaning you do not pay for servers when no one is using it.

services.name: Amazon S3
services.desc: Stores the website frontend files securely.

services.name: Amazon API Gateway
services.desc: Connects the website frontend to the backend code.

services.name: AWS Lambda
services.desc: Runs the code that sends your message to the AI model.

services.name: Amazon Bedrock
services.desc: Provides the AI intelligence to generate responses.

services.name: Amazon DynamoDB
services.desc: Saves a log of all chat messages and metadata.

services.name: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
services.desc: Manages security permissions between the services.
